title: ‘Direct assault on accountability’: CenterLaw hits US’ sanctions vs ICC

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawyers of the victims of the Duterte administration’s war on drugs condemned what it described as the US government’s “dangerous assault on global justice, accountability, and rule of law”. CenterLaw, which has advocated domestically and internationally for the rights, protection, and interests of the relatives of all the victims of extrajudicial killings, pointed out how the US government is weaponizing emergency powers to economically coerce the ICC. “The US government has sought to uphold the very patterns of impunity the ICC seeks to challenge: a world where the powerful are immune from prosecution or accountability, while the victims […]...
